hdate_args.description: List of fully-formed command-line arguments for hdate(1). Each item is a single command-line argument string (e.g., '-s', '-R', '4', '2031', '-l32', '-L34', '-z2'). Arguments are emitted one-per-line in the rendered config file, in order, and may include positional arguments and options mixed as needed per hdate invocation semantics. Every item must be a string, never a compound or nested structure. No validation is performed — it is assumed that the caller ensures syntactic correctness per manpage semantics. See sample_values for examples of real-world usage patterns. See NOTES/LOCATIONS for how -l/-L/-z affect output accuracy. See OPTIONS for valid short/long option strings.
